rules.title: Massachusetts rent control ballot question (2026 initiative petition)
rules.requirement: A proposed statewide ballot initiative would have limited annual rent increases for residences, with exemptions for several types of units, including ones operated solely for religious purposes. The Supreme Judicial Court ruled it cannot go on the November 2026 ballot because the religious exemption means it relates to religion.
rules.citation: Massachusetts rent control ballot question (2026 initiative petition)
rules.status_basis: The Supreme Judicial Court ruled on 2026-06-23 that the petition cannot go forward on the November 2026 ballot; proponents hinted at a 2028 petition.

coverage.summary: Would apply to residences generally, with the specific rent-increase cap not stated in the article.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempts several types of units, including ones operated solely for religious purposes.

rules.quoted_span: The proposal limits annual rent increases for residences, but it carved out exemptions for several types of units, including ones “operated solely for … religious … purposes."
